01 / THE ARCHITECTURE

Less between you
and the chain.

One continuous path from network gossip to usable data. Verify what you receive. Keep what you need. Serve what comes next.

⌁

Go directly to peers.

Join consensus and execution networks. Receive blocks, fetch receipts and fill missing ranges without calling an L1 or L2 RPC at runtime.

CONSENSUS + EXECUTION P2P
⌘

Verify. Then trust.

Validate sequencer signatures and receipt roots. Enable the L1 light client to follow safe and finalized heads from Ethereum.

CRYPTOGRAPHIC VERIFICATION
▤

Your history. Your hardware.

Keep a local archive with no external database. Scale to a fleet with immutable, finalized chunks in object storage.

LOCAL ARCHIVE / R2 FLEET

right now.

Backfill from the archive, then follow the live chain. Build indexers, analytics and applications on the same verified data.
